name: HIPAA Security Rule
publisher: US Dept. of Health and Human Services
description: Administrative, physical and technical safeguards required of covered entities and business associates handling protected health information.

items.note: 164.312(a)(2)(iv) — addressable, but a breach of encrypted PHI is not reportable.
164.308(a)(6) — security incident procedures, with a 60-day breach notification clock.
164.308(a)(7)(ii)(A)-(D) — data backup and disaster recovery, with testing.
